validation.result: Kubernetes and GitOps manifest contracts passed

rollback_procedure: Doi targetRevision trong gitops/application.yaml sang tag truoc do.
Commit va push; Argo CD sync theo desired state moi.
Kiem tra replicas, gateway route va trace sau khi sync.
Khong sua truc tiep tren cluster; selfHeal=true se revert live edit.

drift_self_heal.reason: Khong co cluster Kubernetes va Argo CD trong moi truong lab nay. Manifest va sync policy da validate tinh; drift/self-heal chua chay that.

why_image_tag_is_immutable: Tag 3.0.0 co dinh nen rollback la doi con tro Git, khong phai build lai. Dung :latest thi khong ro dang chay ban nao va khong rollback duoc.
